- `--studied`, which records today as a study day for the "days studied in a row" counter
- `--topic`, `--start` and `--json` options
- a "Why you missed them" breakdown and a "Missed more than once" section

```
Missed more than once:
  3x  Insulin timing (r1, r3, r5)
  2x  fall prevention (r2, r4)
```
